scientific_integrity: Finite exact exhaustive proof with two independently written implementations, explicit maximum-length paths and complete five-good state space. No authorship or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly five goods, two agents, the fixed alternating order, additive rank-consistent strictly positive valuations, and adjacent report transpositions only. Local terminal state need not be unrestricted Nash. The 6-step truthful-start extremal path need not choose a globally best allowed move. No extension to arbitrary item counts. Independent scientific audit not performed.
title: Sharp adjacent-swap convergence lengths for two-agent five-good round robin
